EXPORT ZZT_NUM() BEGIN LOCAL a,b,ok:=1; IFERR F1:="X+(0,1)"; THEN ok:=0; END; IFERR a:=F1(2); THEN a:="error"; END; IFERR b:=F1((2,0)); THEN b:="error"; END; RETURN STRING({ok,STRING(F1),a,TYPE(a),b,TYPE(b)}); END;
EXPORT ZZT_NUM() BEGIN F1:="1/X"; NumStart:=0; NumStep:=1; RETURN 1; END;
EXPORT ZZT_NUM() BEGIN F1:="X+(0,1)"; NumStart:=0; NumStep:=0.1; HComplex:=1; AComplex:=1; RETURN STRING({HComplex,AComplex}); END;
EXPORT ZZT_NUM() BEGIN LOCAL a,b; F1:="X^2"; IFERR a:=F1(1E400); THEN a:="error"; END; F1:="-X^2"; IFERR b:=F1(1E400); THEN b:="error"; END; RETURN STRING({a,TYPE(a),b,TYPE(b)}); END;
EXPORT ZZT_NUM() BEGIN STARTAPP("Function"); AAngle:=1; NumStart:=0; NumStep:=0.1; RETURN AAngle; END;

interpretation: Zoom In retains the selected X: row2 atX0.2 changes start0/step0.1 to start0.1/step0.05.
Go To selects row5 even with Small Font: value5 with step0.1 gives start4.5. Direct entry at row1 instead retains row1.
Plot→ requires explicit confirmation before changing settings, then copies xmin and span/318.
Trig with app angle Gradians3 gives step7.5 on firmware15751; do not convert that to25/3.

The first probe mislabeled an Integer menu choice as Decimal after Un-Zoom enlarged the menu, and mis-clicked Font after closing the view. Those captures are excluded; the second probe established actual Decimal and fonts.

A fresh empty Numeric view retains an X column of65 pixels and a blue unused area. Five checked functions use minimum59-pixel columns; right navigation toF5 shifts dependent columns40 pixels while keeping X fixed.
Some reference6 Font clicks selected the wrong menu; only measured font heights and correctly identified capture pixels are used, not those misleading filenames.
Numeric preserves real inputs as large as 1E400 and as small as 1E-400. X/1E400 and X/1E-400 produce finite ratios rather than losing the independent values to binary floating point.
Numeric uses a capital E for exponents and grouping separators when enabled: the original grid displays 10,000 for start 10000 and step 1000.
An explicit complex function body X+(0,1) returns a complex value in PPL, while its Numeric cells display NaN. A division by zero displays NaN in that cell and continues calculating other rows.

Original Function evaluation saturates positive and negative overflowing results at signed 9.99999999999E499. Native still reports overflow for this case; saturation is a required remaining difference.
The separate root/complex-mode probes have unresolved context-sensitive results. They are excluded from a simple complex-mode contract and do not justify reversing the documented On/Off choices.

A separately captured Zoom menu and direct tap on Trig establish radians code1 as step0.1308996939. An earlier keyboard-navigation attempt selected In and gave0.05; that attempt is excluded from the Trig contract.
